name: OnePlus TV (Cebu)
summary: OnePlus TV (Cebu, India) ships with telemetry, content rows and auto-installs. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This OnePlus TV is a classic Android TV 10 set sold in India. It ships with telemetry and diagnostics, OnePlus content and recommendation rows, auto-installs, and preloaded extras. The list also covers casting, mirroring and streaming apps, which are switched off by choice, so you can keep any of them.

It was checked with a restart, and nothing came back on. HDMI, Live TV, the Input key, the Netflix key and the Assistant mic all kept working. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The remote service and TV keyboard
notes: Factory apps are left alone and never opened.
Debugging keeps its Wi-Fi port open across restarts until you switch it off, so turn debugging off when you are done.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work?

faq.a: Yes. The OnePlus update services are kept on purpose.

faq.q: Does it have a way back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on in one tap, and puts the old home screen back if you changed it.
